atoms.text: Jack says: „I'm sad, because my parents told me last week that we are moving to Cambridge after the summer holidays. But I don't want to move because my friends live here in Manchester. My best friend Muhammed and I spend every day together. After school, we often play football in the park or play video games at his place. At the weekends, we go to the cinema or go to the shopping centre. If we move, I won't see him anymore. I won't find a friend like him in Cambridge. I will miss him very much.“

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Dialog zwischen Pinar und ihrem Vater.

atoms.a: Papa. Ich möchte nicht nach Brighton umziehen. Bitte lass uns in London bleiben.
atoms.b: Dad. I ((++don't_want want)) to move to Brighton. Please, let us ((++stay move)) in London.
atoms.sound: Dad. I don't want to move to Brighton. Please, let us stay in London.

atoms.a: Ich weiß, das ist schwer für dich, aber wir müssen nach Brighton umziehen. Wieso willst du denn nicht umziehen?
atoms.b: I know this is hard for you, but we have to ((++move change)) to Brighton. ((++Why When)) don't you want to move?
atoms.sound: I know this is hard for you, but we have to move to Brighton. Why don't you want to move?

atoms.a: Wenn wir umziehen, werde ich meine besten Freunde verlieren. Ich werde Lucia und Shiyan nie wieder sehen.
atoms.b: If we move, I will ((++lose leave)) my best friends. I ((++will want)) never see Lucia and Shiyan again.
atoms.sound: If we move, I will lose my best friends. I will never see Lusia and Shiyan again.

atoms.a: Ich verstehe, dass du dir Sorgen machst, aber du wirst deine Freunde nicht verlieren. Du kannst deine Freunde in den Schulferien sehen. Wenn du magst, kannst du sie besuchen und sie dich.
atoms.b: I understand that you're worried, but you ((++won't can't)) lose your friends. You can see them in the ((++holidays school)). If you want, you can ((++visit show)) them, and they can visit you.
atoms.sound: I understand that you're worried, but you won't lose your friends. You can see them in the holidays. If you want, you can visit them, and they can visit you.

atoms.a: Aber ich werde dort keine neuen Freunde finden. Niemand mag die gleichen Dinge, die ich mag, nur Lucia und Shiyan haben das getan. Ich werde allein sein auf der neuen Schule.
atoms.b: But I won't find ((++new old)) friends. Nobody likes the things I like, only Lucia and Shiyan did. I will be ((++lonely happy)) at the new school.
atoms.sound: But I won't find new friends. Nobody likes the things I like, only Lusia and Shiyan did. I will be lonely at the new school.

atoms.a: Keine Angst. Du wirst neue Freunde finden. Du kannst Schulklubs beitreten, um andere zu treffen, die ähnliche Dinge mögen wie du.
atoms.b: Don't worry. You will ((++make_new_friends see_old_friends)). You can ((++join tell)) clubs at your new school to meet others who like similar things as you.
atoms.sound: Don't worry. You will make new friends. You can join clubs at your new school to meet others who like similar things as you.

atoms.a: Das hört sich nach einer guten Idee an!
atoms.b: That sounds like a good idea!
atoms.sound: That sounds like a good idea!
